summary.bn: পানি যত অম্লীয়, AO পিনের ভোল্টেজ তত বেশি। pH ৭-এ প্রায় ২.৫ ভোল্ট।
summary.en: The more acid the water, the higher AO. About 2.5 V at pH 7.

simplified: AO is 2.5 V at pH 7 on a 5 V supply and changes about 0.18 V for each pH unit, higher for acid, as sellers and users report for the common PH-4502C board after its offset is set. It is taken as a share of the supply. A real probe must be calibrated with buffer solutions, and its slope changes with temperature and age.
The board's pins are marked Po and Do; the lab calls them AO and DO, like its other modules. Its temperature output (To) is not modelled.
Its comparator (DO) switches when AO passes the trimmer's setting, that is, when the water is more acid than the setting.
It answers at once; a real probe takes seconds to settle.
The resistances inside the module are estimates.
